title:
Comment of Josh Phillips in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15424-000
Submission Date: 10/20/2026

documents.name: 151724.txt
documents.text:
Josh Phillips, Highlands Ranch, CO.
A data center should not be built underwater in a place where engangered right whales make their home. Data centers warm their environments and emit loud noise. Our ecosystem is fragile enough with the quick advance of climate change, and 73% of species have been lost to us in the last 50+ years. We do not need to further risk further decline of a precious endangered species by disrupting their ocean home. Thank you for you consideration.
